body:
### Summary

Hi,

I noticed that in some of our CI jobs, the command `uv run --frozen -m modulename` exits with code 141 (128+13 = `SIGPIPE`). This happens under high IO load.

After a long AI-powered investigation I tracked that to a behavior in `uv` regarding SIGPIPE handling in the network code.

Namely:
- an HTTP/2 connection to a repository gets closed due to timeout;
- `uv` gets a `SIGPIPE` (and a `writev` sees `EPIPE`);
- `uv` forwards it to its child (through code added in #13017 I believe);
- if it's early enough in `python` startup code, the signal is not yet ignored;
- `python` dies because of `SIGPIPE`;
- `uv` exits with code 141.

I'm attaching a (AI-generated) repro case based on docker. Tested on 0.12.8. [uv-sigpipe-repro.sh](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32554046/uv-sigpipe-repro.sh)

Not sure what the correct fix is for this, but happy to provide more info if needed.

Thanks!

### Platform

Linux amd64

### Version

0.12.8

### Python version

3.13.5
title: Race condition in SIGPIPE causes network errors to kill uv run
